added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own logs rather than from its manifest: manifest.md carries no baseline_suite and no after_suite line, but logs/budget_base_vs_head.log runs tests/test_mcp_response_budget.py against both arms of every path this node's gate names and both arms end `5 failed, 3 passed` with the same five ids ([crew-scopes], [crew-live], test_every_other_read_tool_uses_the_same_ceiling[read_plan], test_every_other_read_tool_uses_the_same_ceiling[audit], test_an_under_budget_read_is_exactly_its_pre_ceiling_answer), EXIT=1, so the id-level delta is zero. logs/head_gate.log's own five failing ids are those five and none of them is in a file this node changed.

0.reason: roadmap raw and audit raw are the lossless editing views; the section names detail, read_plan raw and section, and findings, and the fragment discloses the raw exemption

2.reason: the section specifies that the test holds each view to its row in the table; a real regression is caught by the response_over_budget assertion and by the detail-paging test

findings.text: LOSSLESS_VIEWS exempts roadmap raw and audit raw from the done-when's "none returns response_over_budget" half, so the control the plan states is asserted for neither view; roadmap raw still returns response_over_budget on the 60-plan fixture and the fragment discloses it, so it is recorded rather than held against the landing.

the paging branch of _paged_findings is never taken by any gate: every fixture carries no findings, so the empty-groups guard at :2475 returns before paginate() and the one view the plan names as over budget at limit=20 is measured only as a no-op, leaving a regression in it uncaught.

the right-hand side of the size assertion is view_budget(tool_name, arguments), read from the same VIEW_BUDGETS table the test exists to hold, so the two sides move together if any row is raised and the assertion stays green; the guard that does fire on a real regression is the response_over_budget check at :218 and test_roadmap_detail_fits_by_paging_rather_than_by_refusing at :229.

justifications.durability: logs/negative_control.log shows tests/test_every_default_read_fits.py reddening at 2 failed when the paging is removed, but only the roadmap detail path was mutated and reckon/mcp_views.py:2477's findings paging is never exercised with a non-empty payload.
justifications.evidence: logs/head_gate.log records the gate at 5 failed/51 passed EXIT=1 and logs/fixture_arms.log records the base arm as response_over_budget, but the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite are null, so the delta it claims rests on a log its manifest does not name.
justifications.fit: the two page helpers join the paginate idiom already at reckon/mcp_views.py:2406 and every new name describes its mechanism, with no plan identifier in a path, symbol or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/mcp_budget.py:22 holds every read view to a declared row and reckon/mcp_views.py:3578 stops roadmap view=detail serialising the whole report, which is the goal's own words.
justifications.reuse: no per-view budget owner existed; VIEW_BUDGETS extends reckon/mcp_budget.py, which already owns response_ceiling and serialised_characters, and all three views reuse the existing paginate() rather than a second pager.
justifications.scope_discipline: all four changed paths (reckon/mcp_budget.py, reckon/mcp_views.py, tests/test_every_default_read_fits.py, the fragment) are inside the declared write paths, and no figure or extra prose was added.
